status: Final candidate specification after one documented known-case development revision; acceptance criteria unchanged; awaiting local freeze before fresh validation
purpose: Test whether observed-signal gating, explicit uncertainty and physical resource transfer delay reduce adverse cases while preserving original-horizon backlog performance

scenario_design.families: All eleven v0.2 families unchanged; no family selected or removed using v0.3 policy results

legacy_families.source: data/load_test_summary_per_minute.csv, original synthetic requests including retries and bots
legacy_families.generator: simulation.scenarios unchanged, with fresh split seeds

generated_families.source: independently specified synthetic arrivals; does not use the source CSV
generated_families.rng: numpy default_rng SeedSequence([20261125, generated_group_index, scenario_seed, stream]); stream 0 arrivals, stream 1 productivity
generated_families.arrivals: Poisson of piecewise/sinusoidal demand * Uniform(0.9,1.1) episode scale * independent LogNormal(-0.5*0.08^2,0.08) minute factor; phase Uniform(0,2*pi)
generated_families.fault_factor: Uniform(0.42,0.62) per episode for specified abrupt faults

groups.generated_underload: demand 4800+1400*sin(2*pi*t/31+phase), zero demand [64,72); stage-1 productivity multiplied by 0.75 in [24,44). Tests censored-throughput inference and avoiding unnecessary moves.
groups.generated_sustained_processing_fault: demand 10500, 4500 before minute 12 and 5500 from minute 72; stage-1 productivity multiplied by fault_factor in [16,64).
groups.generated_switching_fault: demand 10000+1500*sin(2*pi*t/37+phase), 4000 before minute 10 and 5000 from minute 80; fault_factor applied to stage 0 [14,31), stage 2 [31,39), stage 1 [39,59), stage 0 [59,71).
groups.generated_pulsed_short_fault: base demand 4500; pulses (start,length,height): (12,5,23500),(31,3,28000),(51,7,20500),(74,4,25000). Three-minute faults at stage/start (1,13),(0,32),(2,53),(1,75); each is shorter than dwell.
groups.generated_asymmetric_recovery: base demand 9500, 4500 before minute 12 and from minute 80; base productivity multipliers [1.35,0.72,1.18]; stage 2 additional multiplier 0.58 in [20,48); stage 1 additional multiplier 1.55 in [48,72).
groups.generated_sustained_overload: demand 18000+1200*sin(2*pi*t/29+phase), 5000 before minute 10 and 6000 from minute 80; stage 2 multiplier 0.75 in [32,56).

development.status: Known prior v0.2 validation cases reused openly as v0.3 development; not held out

validation.status: New seeds, not used in development or evaluated before final freeze

resource_model.instant: Original v0.2 zero-delay physics: donor removal and recipient activation before this minute processing
resource_model.transit: At action minute t donors lose transferred resources immediately. Recipients gain them before processing minute t+D. Incoming resources are unavailable for exactly D processing minutes. Active plus in-transit resources always equals207.
resource_model.accounting: Only actual available capacity processes work. No resource creation, no work dropping, no arbitrary money penalty.
resource_model.observation: Past service-rate estimates must divide by active resources, not committed incoming resources. A policy adapter may expose committed target allocations for a frozen controller budget check while it is dwell-locked; eligible transfers occur after previous arrivals because D<8.
resource_model.constraints: Original action catalog and warmup5/dwell8; root freezes any per-policy reserve or veto differences explicitly

followup.productivity: Constant last true original-horizon productivity row for all32 follow-up minutes
followup.assumption: A prespecified synthetic drainage condition, not observed real recovery or a predicted service future
followup.information_boundary: The policy is not told originalH, the follow-up switch, future arrivals or true productivity; it continues on ordinary observations
followup.metrics: Score originalH separately. Tail mean and AUC use end-of-minute backlog at H..H+31. Clearance time is0 if already empty at H, else first subsequent zero-backlog observation1..32; if still nonempty, censor and cap time at32.

policy_roles.abc_capacity: Unchanged v0.2 ABC-proposal veto mode with seeds11,29,47
policy_roles.capacity_balance: Simple inverse-estimated-rate allocation comparator; implementation/configuration frozen by root
policy_roles.v3_signal_only: v0.2 prediction mechanism with new observed persistence/separation veto; ablation specified by root
policy_roles.v3_full: New observed veto plus per-stage uncertainty ensemble and known physical transit delay prediction; implementation/configuration frozen by root

policy_observations: Current external arrivals and queues, prior actual active allocations, completed flow and end queues; declared transport delay is known. Future environment arrays and scenario labels are excluded.

scoring.primary: Mean total unfinished work at end of each minute over original H only; 60-minute legacy and96-minute generated cases each contribute one per-case time average
scoring.loss_units: resource_minutes_lost is the sum of inactive in-transit resources during original H; tail loss is separate; no monetary interpretation
scoring.risk: For each paired case, positive harm is max(candidate mean backlog - comparator mean backlog,0). Harm frequency uses1e-6 tolerance. Report mean positive harm, maximum harm and CVaR90.
scoring.cvar90: Mean of the worst10% of empirical positive-part case harms, with fractional weight at the boundary so tail mass is exactly10%; harms are computed after averaging policy draws
scoring.static_relative_risk: Report every policy relative to Static, then compare the frequency/mean-harm/CVaR risk profiles of v3_full to V2 with the same paired bootstrap. This is different from candidate-minus-V2 harm.

analysis.regimes: Analyze each delay regime separately; no pooled mean across transport regimes
analysis.weighting: Average ABC seeds within each family/scenario/regime, then equally weight cases; equal case counts per family
analysis.bootstrap: 2000 paired percentile resamples within each family; all policy outcomes for a case move together
analysis.noninferiority_scope: Predeclared engineering allowance, not an observed achievement. Exact primary and advancement conditions are in acceptance_criteria.
analysis.source_and_family_reporting: Preserve separate legacy_flash and generated_synthetic slices and all11 family effects, including zero baselines and adverse cases
analysis.zero_denominator: Relative reductions and ratio CIs are null if baseline mean is zero; absolute harm remains reportable
analysis.censoring: Mean capped drain time is restricted to32 minutes; report uncleared fraction alongside it, never average only cleared cases and call that overall clearance time
analysis.interval_scope: Conditional Monte Carlo variation of these synthetic families and fixed policy seeds. Does not cover simulator/model uncertainty, alternative workloads or deployment.
analysis.multiplicity: Only explicitly frozen decision comparisons support the acceptance rule; secondary/source/family intervals are descriptive and unadjusted

integrity: Root specifies and verifies original-frozen source hashes, new source/protocol hashes, active+in-transit budget, work conservation, catalog/reserve/dwell, observation-only decisions, drain accounting and independent representative replays
no_tuning: No policy, generator, configuration, metric or acceptance-rule changes after validation outcomes. Any change starts a new version and validation design.
limitations: Arrival and productivity families are reused, even though validation seeds are new; all cases share the same sequential fluid queue simulator.
Resource transport models a specific source of lost capacity but not arbitrary migration effects, service startup, rollback, contention or monetary cost.
Zero-arrival constant-productivity drainage is an explicit artificial follow-up assumption.
A lower case-average backlog does not imply more completed work, lower real latency, smaller terminal backlog, or no adverse individual cases.
Passing any engineering criterion supports further experiments, not automatic live control or a formal guarantee.

acceptance_criteria.status: Specified before validation and before inspecting v0.3 development outcomes; the 5% engineering margin was declared before development execution

primary.condition: lower endpoint of paired95% absolute mean-improvement CI >0

noninferiority.condition: lower endpoint of paired95% reduction_pct CI >=-5.0%
noninferiority.meaning: Permits up to5% less favorable mean performance than V2 as a prespecified engineering allowance in exchange for lower downside; it is not a proof that an outcome satisfies that allowance
noninferiority.zero_denominator: When the V2 mean is zero, use the absolute-improvement lower CI endpoint >=-1e-6, corresponding to a zero relative allowance with numerical tolerance

advancement_all_required.condition: Both the primary and noninferiority criteria pass
v3_full point mean backlog <= Static point mean backlog +1e-6
For every regime, the paired95% absolute mean-backlog improvement lower CI endpoint versus Static >0
For every regime, v3_full point CVaR90 of positive case mean-backlog harm relative to Static is strictly less than the corresponding capacity_v2 point CVaR90, or both CVaRs are zero within1e-6
For every regime, v3_full point mean32-minute tail AUC <= capacity_v2 point mean tail AUC +1e-6
For every regime, v3_full point mean original-H end backlog <= capacity_v2 point mean original-H end backlog +1e-6

All declared invariant checks and tests pass. Every v3_full generated_underload episode in every regime has zero backlog and no reallocation over original H and follow-up, within1e-6 for work/resource values

acceptance_criteria.reporting: Report each criterion separately, including every failed regime/family. An overall pass is an intersection of these declared engineering conditions; secondary intervals remain unadjusted.
acceptance_criteria.scope: Advancement supports broader experimentation only. It does not establish universal non-regression, deployment safety, statistical familywise coverage or a formal stability guarantee.
acceptance_criteria.no_retuning: No changes to acceptance thresholds, sources, policy or metrics after validation outcomes. Any later variant requires a new version and new validation design.

final_policy_semantics.evidence: Recipient has at least two saturated observations in the last five and latest end queue >10; additionally recipient upper current capacity < maximum donor lower current capacity OR all five observations saturated. Separation is from at least one donor, not every donor.
final_policy_semantics.bands: Point rate +/-15% after two busy observations, otherwise +/-25%, expanded to recent busy extrema +/-15%; conservative lower anchor prevents prior reversion alone from implying donor recovery. Engineering stress assumptions, not confidence intervals.
final_policy_semantics.base_forecasts: Nine unchanged V2 design forecasts. Rank mean gain on those nine. Require nonnegative gain in each and mean gain > max(10,2% mean hold cost).
final_policy_semantics.full_stress: Append 8 independent low/high per-stage corners at each of 3 demand factors, making 24 stress forecasts and33 total. Each stress forecast permits at most5% relative cost regression against holding, with hold-cost floor1.
final_policy_semantics.full_terminal: Mean terminal-backlog change in the original nine forecasts must be nonpositive.
final_policy_semantics.full_delay: Joint allocation forecast removes incoming resources for the known0/1/3 complete intervals; holds lose no capacity. No additional additive migration penalty.
final_policy_semantics.ablation: Signal-only uses the same evidence prefilter but the original nine forecasts, assumeszero transfer delay, and omits the full terminal veto. The full-versus-ablation contrast combines these mechanisms; even instant comparisons retain both corner and terminal-veto differences.
final_policy_semantics.capacity_balance: Same observed point-rate estimator, legal action catalogue, five-minute warmup, eight-minute dwell and reserve10. If any stage end queue exceeds10 in each of the lasttwo observations, select a move reducing squared distance from target allocation207*(1/rate)/sum(1/rate); otherwisehold.
final_policy_semantics.development: One initial instant-only trial and one final three-regime development run, all on known seeds1000..1003. Initial artifacts and V3_DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md preserved. No further policy tuning despite disappointing development outcomes.
final_policy_semantics.allowances_distinct: The5% per-stress-forecast allowance was a development choice. The5% statistical noninferiority engineering margin was specified before development outcomes and remains unchanged.
